column1: # Shape labels for Tomokiyo's two alphabet tables (JuanManuel.png, AlonsoSanchez.png), read by eye at 3x by R11-RJMSIB,
# 6 Oct 2026. One row per drawn sign. letter 'null' = Tomokiyo's nulls column. firm=0 marks a sign Tomokiyo drew with '?',
# in grey, or whose column is ambiguous. Shared vocabulary: alpha (fish/alpha), tt_o (crossed tt + o), tt_hash (tt + #),
# tt_bar (two t's under one bar), hash (#), g_tail (g/9 with long tail), oo_linked (two linked o's, infinity), epsilon_big,
# epsilon, yogh (3/z with tail or flat top), venus (circle over a cross), x, x_stroke (x with a stroke), Lo (L or k + o),
# co (raised c/e + small o), others named by their look.
